(1)       

Under the two-class method, earnings per share is calculated using net earnings allocable to common shares, which is derived by reducing net earnings by the earnings allocable to participating securities.  Net earnings allocable to common shares used in the basic and diluted earnings per share calculation were $1,668 million and $1,612 million for the three months ended October 30, 2026, and October 31, 2025, respectively.  Net earnings allocable to common shares used in the basic and diluted earnings per share calculation were $5,684 million and $5,639 million for the nine months ended October 30, 2026, and October 31, 2025, respectively.
